The changes made in this patch ensure that all accesses to the `planes` member are correctly referencing the `vb2_buf` structure, thereby restoring the intended functionality and preventing potential bugs related to incorrect memory reads/writes. This fix is crucial for maintaining the integrity of video encoding and decoding operations in the MediaTek video codec driver.
